description: LogEntryId is a newtype over [u8; 32] but does not derive Copy. Arrays of fixed size implement Copy, so LogEntryId can trivially derive Copy. Without Copy, all LogEntryId usages require explicit .clone() calls, which appear ~15 times across backfill, reconcile, append, and the integration tests. Derive Copy alongside Clone to eliminate the noise.
title: core: LogEntryId should implement Copy; it is a [u8; 32] newtype
